fold_algorithm: CardDatabase::fold_card_name_key (card_db.rs) feeding canonical_deck_count_key (deck_validation.rs): resolve the entry name through the card database to its canonical printing, then fold (lowercase) to the deck-count key. Both alias spellings resolve to the same canonical key, so the engine merges the buckets.
